_meta.note: Manufacturer sell sheets and spec sheets the Express shop links from an open tile. Each file lives in the repo's "spec sheets" folder and is served only through /api/shop/spec-sheet/<id>; a file that is not listed here is never served. `models` are the model numbers printed on the sheet. To add one: drop the PDF in "spec sheets", add an entry, push.
